title: 2027 Lexus ES Hybrid Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: The 2027 Lexus ES Hybrid Lexus is unchanged for the new model year, following a complete redesign for 2026.
body_markdown:
Buyers have shown a distinct preference for crossovers and SUVs, but luxury sedans such as the Lexus ES remain available and offer comfort, efficiency, and style in equal proportions. The 2027 Lexus ES is offered with both electric and hybrid powertrain options. This article covers the ES 350h hybrid model.


## 2027 Lexus ES Hybrid Pricing, Specs, and Release Date

## What’s New for the 2027 Lexus ES Hybrid


Considering the ES was all-new for the 2026 model year, it’s not surprising that Lexus didn’t make any significant changes for 2027. Every 2027 Lexus ES is equipped with a new 12.3-inch driver multi-information display that serves as a digital gauge cluster, and the newest version of the Lexus Safety System+ 4.0 is also standard across the board.


## Design


The latest Lexus ES wears sharp bodywork with facets and creases that draw the eye. The roofline’s rakish slope gives the 2027 ES a coupe-like profile, and the jagged bodyline is an interesting detail. At the front, the familiar Lexus spindle grille is evident, but only the very bottom portion is open to let in air. A set of 19-inch 10-spoke aluminum wheels with aerodynamic covers is standard. The current ES is 6.5 inches longer (on a wheelbase that’s stretched by an additional 3.1 inches), 2.2 inches wider, and 4.5 inches taller than the version it replaced. That adds extra interior space, particularly for rear-seat passengers.


## Powertrain


The 2027 Lexus ES 350h comes standard with a 2.5-liter four-cylinder engine, a starter generator, a front motor generator, and an electronically controlled continuously variable automatic transmission (CVT). Front-wheel drive (FWD) is standard. Models equipped with all-wheel drive (AWD) get an additional motor that powers the rear wheels. Either way, Lexus rates the ES 350h at 244 horsepower. The EPA estimates that the 2027 Lexus ES 350h with FWD will return 48 mpg in the city, 44 mpg on the highway, and 46 mpg combined. With AWD, the ES Hybrid returns 47 mpg city, 42 mpg highway, and 44 mpg combined.


## Interior


All 2027 Lexus ES 350h models come standard with NuLuxe synthetic leather trim for the seating, door panel accents, and dashboard. There’s also an ambient lighting system called Thematic Ambient Illumination. The front seats are eight-way power-adjustable, heated, and ventilated. Unlike fully electric ES models, Lexus does not offer the ES Hybrid with an executive-class rear-seat package. Still, the back seat is extremely roomy and comfortable for two adults.


## Technology


Every 2027 ES comes standard with a 12.3-inch display screen that serves as a digital gauge cluster, along with a 14-inch infotainment touchscreen. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity are standard, as is a wireless device charger. A 10-speaker Lexus Premium Sound System is standard, and Premium+ trims benefit from a 17-speaker, 1,800-watt Mark Levinson PurePlay Surround Sound System. Owners with an active Drive Connect trial or subscription have access to Cloud Navigation and Lexus’ Intelligent Assistant. A Remote Connect trial or subscription gives ES owners access to an app that can lock and unlock doors, remotely start the engine, adjust the car’s climate control, check the car’s health status, and more.

## Safety


The Lexus Safety System+ 4.0, which is standard on all 2027 ES models, includes a comprehensive suite of driver-assistance features. Adaptive cruise control, automatic emergency braking, lane-keep assist, lane-departure warning, traffic-sign recognition, high-beam assist, and more are all included. Traffic-jam assist, lane-change assist, front cross-traffic alert, and rear pedestrian detection are also available. The current ES sedan had not been crash-tested by the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety or the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration at the time of writing.


## Pricing and Release Date


The 2027 Lexus ES 350h Premium started at $51,200, including destination, at the time of writing. A Cold Weather Package with a radiant knee heater, windshield wiper de-icer, and headlamp washers is optional, as is a Convenience Package that includes additional safety technologies such as front cross-traffic alert and lane-change assist. In Premium+ trim, the ES 350h starts at $56,000, and opting for AWD adds $1,400 to the MSRP of either trim level.
